instructions_to_main_agent: Apply a light theme globally. Use a clean off-white (#F8FAFC / bg-slate-50) for the main application background and pure white (#FFFFFF / bg-white) for cards and surfaces to mimic Dash Pro.
Retain the existing Dash Pro font (like Cairo/Tajawal) keeping text crisp and highly readable.

Enhance the search functionality: In the Dashboard and Operations views, ensure the search input filters against 4 criteria: Name, File Number, Operation, and Plate Number. Update the search input placeholder to reflect this in Arabic.
Update the Vehicle Cards layout: Locate the 'File Number' field in the dashboard cards and move it to sit directly below the 'Brand and Model' field.
Prefix the File Number with the word 'رقم ' so it renders as 'رقم ملف' followed by the number.
Ensure the modified 'File Number' field maintains the exact same font size and styling it originally had.
Ensure all UI is fully RTL compliant (dir='rtl'), aligning icons, paddings, and flex layouts correctly for Arabic text.
